content:
### Why Window and Exterior Remodeling Is Different From Other Trades

Window replacement and exterior remodeling projects are high-consideration purchases. Homeowners typically research for weeks or months before deciding — and during that period, brands they have seen consistently in their neighborhood carry a significant advantage over brands encountered for the first time through a Google search or mailer.

Most window companies invest heavily in digital ads and lead generation during the consideration phase. Very few invest in the recognition-building that happens before the consideration phase begins.

 

### Building Recognition Before the Consideration Phase

SIT GroundForce™ addresses the pre-consideration phase directly. Structured neighborhood outreach —consistent, non-salesy, focused on home value and maintenance conversations —builds brand familiarity with homeowners before they are actively shopping.

When those homeowners enter the consideration phase three to six months later, your company is already the recognized, familiar option.

 

### Exclusivity as the Investment Protector

Window and exterior remodeling projects have long sales cycles — which makes it critical that your territory investment benefits your brand exclusively. SIT™ approves one window and exterior remodeling partner per defined territory. Your outreach builds recognition for your company — not for a competitor in the same program.
